chapters.summary: Paul writes to Philemon on behalf of the runaway slave Onesimus, pleading with him to forgive and receive Onesimus as a brother, displaying the love and forgiveness of Christ.
keyPoints: Paul commends Philemon's love and faith, and prays for him, asking that the sharing of his faith would become effectual.
Paul pleads on behalf of Onesimus, calling him his son begotten in his bonds, and implores Philemon to receive him as he would receive Paul himself.
Paul promises to repay whatever Onesimus owes, and stresses that Philemon's obedience to Christ should lead him to do even more than what is asked.
chapters.application: Follow Philemon's example: receive with Christ's love those who have wronged you, regard them as brothers and sisters in the Lord, and let forgiveness and reconciliation mark your relationships.
